title: Design System: Jess Pomfret — Changelog Blog

headline.purpose: Hero entry title at the base/md size (3rem).

headline-large.purpose: Hero title scaled up at the xl breakpoint (3.6rem).

title.purpose: Feed entry and section titles at the base size (2rem).

title-large.purpose: Entry/section/closing titles scaled up at md/xl (2.2rem).

body.purpose: Excerpts, card copy, and long-form reading (1.5rem).

body-large.purpose: Hero excerpt and lead paragraphs, set slightly larger (1.7rem).

label.purpose: Date tags, kickers, fact labels; tabular-numeral timestamps (1.3rem).

shadows.name: shadow-l1
shadows.purpose: Rest state for entry/content cards and the hero cover image.

shadows.name: shadow-l2
shadows.purpose: Hover state for cards; permanent state for the hero.

shadows.name: hero-glow-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-mode ambient sky-blue glow around the fixed hero frame card, paired with shadow-l2.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Interactive card hover lift + shadow promotion (the Hover-Lifts Rule).

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.value: theme respond(sm) mixin — card/fact grids go from 1 to 2 columns

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.value: theme respond(md) mixin — hero grows, photo-story rows switch to two-column, fact strip goes to 3 columns

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.value: theme respond(xl) mixin — headline/title font sizes step up to their -large values

components.css: .ds-changelog-entry { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(16,38,93,0.12); padding: 24px; transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; font-family: Garet, sans-serif; } .ds-changelog-entry:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(16,38,93,0.18); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-changelog-entry-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; } .ds-changelog-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; background-color: #530080; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-changelog-categories { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-changelog-categories a { display: inline-block; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0d4a50; background-color: rgba(79,170,179,0.15); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-changelog-categories a:hover, .ds-changelog-categories a:focus-visible { background-color: rgba(79,170,179,0.28); } .ds-changelog-entry-title { font-family: Etna, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2rem; margin: 0; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-changelog-entry-title a { color: #10203f; text-decoration: none; } .ds-changelog-entry-title a:hover, .ds-changelog-entry-title a:focus-visible { color: #530080; } .ds-changelog-entry-excerpt { margin: 0; color: #45507a; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 70ch; } .ds-changelog-entry-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; color: #6b7593; font-size: 1.3rem; }

components.css: .ds-changelog-hero { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 320px; background-image: url('/img/hero-frame-light.png'); background-size: cover; background-position: center; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(16,38,93,0.18); padding: 34px; color: #10265d; font-family: Garet, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-changelog-hero-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; max-width: 480px; } .ds-changelog-hero-eyebrow { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: #7dc4cb; } .ds-changelog-hero-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; } .ds-changelog-tag-hero { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; background-color: #530080; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-changelog-categories-hero { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-changelog-categories-hero a { display: inline-block; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; color: #bdecfe; background-color: #10265d; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-changelog-hero-title { font-family: Etna, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0; color: #10265d; } .ds-changelog-hero-title a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-changelog-hero-excerpt { font-size: 1.7rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(16,38,93,0.75); max-width: 55ch; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The site presents Jess's technical work as an ongoing changelog, not a magazine of interchangeable cards. A fixed sidebar carries the purple octopus mark, name, and socials as constant identity; the main pane is a chronological feed that opens on one always-saturated "latest entry" hero and settles into dated, tag-pilled entries below it. The world runs on a full four-color palette (purple, navy, light-blue, teal) where every hue is an assigned role rather than a decorative accent, paired with two self-hosted brand fonts: Etna Sans Serif for anything that names a thing (headlines, titles) and Garet for anything that explains it (body copy, excerpts).

The hero is the system's one deliberately committed, theme-independent moment: it renders on the fixed Brand Kit octopus/wave frame card regardless of whether the visitor is in light or dark mode, then sits directly above the ordinary token-driven feed. Everything past the hero is flat, quiet, and legible; the saturation is spent entirely on the hero so it doesn't leak into the rest of the page.
keyCharacteristics: Full-palette role assignment: purple leads in light mode, teal leads in dark mode, navy and light-blue are the two grounds.
One fixed frame-card hero per page, everything else theme-responsive.
Etna for names (headlines/titles), Garet for explanations (body/excerpts).
Dated, tag-pilled entries in place of a generic card grid.
The hero's Brand Kit octopus/wave frame card is the system's single piece of illustrative artwork; the feed below it is undivided.

rules.name: The One Saturated Moment Rule
rules.body: Only the hero renders on the fixed Brand Kit frame card — a per-theme octopus/wave PNG with a pale center panel (white in light, sky-blue in dark) that keeps the hero title dark-on-pale in both themes. It is fixed regardless of site theme; every other surface (cards, feed, sidebar) uses the light/dark token pairs.

rules.name: The Single-Teal Tag Rule
rules.body: Every category and tag pill sitewide is teal (#4faab3 background, #06171f text), overriding the theme's default per-term color rotation. One color per taxonomy element, no exceptions.

rules.name: The Etna-Names-It Rule
rules.body: Etna is reserved for anything that identifies an entry (hero title, entry title). Garet carries everything that describes it (excerpts, footers). Neither font substitutes for the other's role.

rules.name: The Hover-Lifts Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards (changelog-entry) respond to hover with both a shadow promotion (l1 to l2) and a 2px upward translation together, never one without the other.

dos: Do treat the four brand colors (purple, navy, light-blue, teal) as named, assigned roles — never introduce a fifth accent hue into the changelog system.
Do keep the hero on the fixed Brand Kit frame-card image in both themes; it is the system's one deliberately saturated surface.
Do set every category/tag pill sitewide in teal, overriding the theme's default per-term color rotation.
Do use Etna for anything that names an entry and Garet for anything that describes it.
Do preserve real tag/category casing as written (capitalizeListTitles = false) — this is a deliberate site behavior reflecting real-world tool names like "dbatools", not a bug to fix.
Do pair a shadow promotion with a translateY lift on hover for interactive cards; never apply one without the other.
donts: Don't swap the hero's fixed frame card back to a per-post cover crop — that was tried and abandoned because posts' cover images carry baked-in title text that collides with the hero's own dynamic title.
Don't add a third card-radius step or a sharp-cornered surface; the system uses exactly two radii (14px card, 6px pill).

Don't treat the single-post article page, archives page, search page, or the Buy the Book / Finding Data Friends pages as redesigned. They currently inherit the global color and font tokens from custom.scss but their structure and composition have not been reviewed against this system yet.

Don't record CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as the project's code license — it is the deliberately-retained content license (article.license.default in params.toml); the separate root LICENSE file covers code under MIT.
